from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template_string import boto3 import os import html import re from datetime import datetime app = Flask(__name__) dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb', region_name=os.environ.get('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1')) table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ.get('COMMENTS_TABLE', 'user-comments')) # Template for rendering comments COMMENT_PAGE = """ Comments for {{ post_id }}

Comments

{% for comment in comments %}
{{ comment.username }} {{ comment.timestamp }}
{{ comment.body | safe }}
{% endfor %}
""" def sanitize_username(username): """Sanitize username - alphanumeric and underscores only""" return re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_]', '', username)[:32] def store_comment(post_id, username, body): """Store comment in DynamoDB with partition key = post_id, sort key = timestamp""" timestamp = datetime.utcnow().isoformat() item = { 'post_id': post_id, 'timestamp': timestamp, 'username': username, 'body': body, 'content_type': 'user_comment', 'visibility': 'public' } table.put_item(Item=item) return item def get_comments(post_id): """Retrieve all comments for a post""" response = table.query( KeyConditionExpression=boto3.dynamodb.conditions.Key('post_id').eq(post_id) ) return response.get('Items', []) @app.route('/api/comments/', methods=['POST']) def post_comment(post_id): username = sanitize_username(request.form.get('username', 'anonymous')) body = request.form.get('body', '') # Length check to prevent abuse if len(body) > 2000: return jsonify({'error': 'Comment too long'}), 400 if not body.strip(): return jsonify({'error': 'Empty comment'}), 400 # NOTE: body is stored as-is for rich text support (markdown rendering planned) # The frontend rendering handles display safety comment = store_comment(post_id, username, body) return jsonify({'status': 'created', 'comment': comment}), 201 @app.route('/comments/', methods=['GET']) def view_comments(post_id): comments = get_comments(post_id) # Render with Jinja2 - body marked as |safe for planned markdown support return render_template_string(COMMENT_PAGE, post_id=post_id, comments=comments) @app.route('/api/comments/', methods=['GET']) def api_get_comments(post_id): comments = get_comments(post_id) # API responses are JSON-encoded (inherently safe) return jsonify({'comments': comments}) @app.route('/health', methods=['GET']) def health(): return jsonify({'status': 'healthy'}), 200 if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080)

environment.description: ECS Fargate service in isolated VPC. Task execution role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DDBItemLevelGate) that enforces dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition. The IAM policy on the task role includes a Deny statement with condition: dynamodb:LeadingKeys does NOT match the pattern 'post-*' via StringNotLike, and a separate condition requiring dynamodb:Attributes to be a subset of ['post_id','timestamp','username','body'] via ForAllValues:StringEquals. Additionally, items written must have content_type='user_comment' enforced via dynamodb:item/content_type condition with StringEquals. The DynamoDB table has a Global Secondary Index on visibility+timestamp used for moderation queries. A VPC endpoint policy for DynamoDB restricts PutItem calls to items where the body attribute length is validated by a Lambda authorizer attached to the ALB target group, which strips HTML tags from the body field before forwarding to the container - implemented as a request-level Lambda@Edge equivalent using ALB Lambda target with path-based routing rule on /api/comments/* that preprocesses the request body through a sanitization function (bleach.clean with strip=True, tags=[], attributes={}) before re-routing to the Fargate target group.

config.alb_configuration: Path-based routing: /api/comments/* -> Lambda sanitizer target group (priority 1), /* -> Fargate target group (priority 2)
config.lambda_sanitizer: Receives POST to /api/comments/*, applies bleach.clean(body, tags=[], attributes={}, strip=True) to form body field, re-invokes Fargate target via internal ALB listener on port 8081
config.task_role_policy: Allow dynamodb:PutItem,Query,GetItem with conditions: dynamodb:LeadingKeys StringLike 'post-*', ForAllValues:StringEquals dynamodb:Attributes ['post_id','timestamp','username','body','content_type','visibility']
config.vpc_endpoint_policy: Allow dynamodb:* from task role ARN only
config.network: internal ALB (port 8081) not exposed externally, public ALB routes /api/comments/* to Lambda first
